note: Single source of truth for the company universe. `symbol` is the NSE trading symbol, which is also the Screener.in company slug and the data/<symbol>.json filename stem. Display names have a trailing corporate suffix (Ltd./Limited) trimmed; `sector` is the NSE macro-industry.

indexMembership.note: Each company's `indices` lists the NSE indices it belongs to. Every entry is in NIFTY 500 (this registry's source list); those also in NIFTY 50 carry that tag too. The active universe is chosen in code by filtering on this field (see ACTIVE_INDEX in scraper/src/companies.ts and src/mocks/companies.ts), so narrowing or widening it never edits this list.
